title: Ukrainian Drones Hit Sberbank Data Center After Yandex Attacks
key_facts: Ukrainian drones targeted a Sberbank data center under construction in Balakovo, Saratov region, overnight into Wednesday 14 Oct 2026.
Sberbank First Deputy CEO Alexander Vedyakhin said banking systems and online services kept running and no employees were hurt (via TASS).
Users reported disruptions to Sberbank and its GigaChat AI service, but the reports did not establish a link to the attack.
The attack follows three consecutive strikes that disabled half of Yandex's data centers; Ukraine says it responds to Russian attacks on its own data sites.
The facility is 55,000 square meters, a 122.2 billion ruble ($1.4 billion) project begun in 2021, completion expected 2030.
Russia's Defense Ministry said it struck seven Ukrainian energy facilities and a data center; Ukrainian adviser Dmytro Lytvyn confirmed Ukraine struck a data center.
quote_evidence: Ukrainian drones targeted a major data center under construction for Russian state lender Sberbank in the Saratov region overnight, First Deputy CEO Alexander Vedyakhin said Wednesday.
The reports did not establish a link between the disruptions and the drone attacks.
why_it_matters_hint: Data centers are becoming repeated targets in the war.
notes: Follow-up of Yandex strikes (our 11 Oct edition).
